title: Product Execution Requirement
description: Experimental. One account resource a buyer must bind on the request, or establish on the account, before a package on this product can be created. The kind determines where the resource goes: `event_source` binds through `packages[].optimization_goals[].event_sources[].event_source_id`, `catalog` binds through `packages[].catalogs[]`, and `downstream_connection` is satisfied by completing the connection rather than by a request field. The requirement states what the product needs, never whether a particular account has it, and MUST NOT carry account-specific resource IDs or names. Alternatives listed inside one requirement are any-of.

oneOf.title: Event source requirement
oneOf.description: Each package on this product needs an optimization goal fed by a conversion event source. Satisfied when at least one `optimization_goals[]` entry of `kind: "event"` on the package has an `event_sources[]` entry that references an event source available to the account — registered through `sync_event_sources`, or seller-managed when the product declares `conversion_tracking.platform_managed: true` — with an `event_type` accepted here. Typical for conversion, website-sales, and app-event products.

event_types.description: Event types that satisfy the requirement (any-of): the satisfying `event_sources[]` entry MUST use one of these `event_type` values. Omit when any event type satisfies it.

oneOf.title: Catalog requirement
oneOf.description: Each package on this product needs a catalog. Satisfied when the package carries a `packages[].catalogs[]` entry whose `type` is one of `catalog_types`. Use `catalog_types: ["app"]` for app-promotion products: an app catalog item carries the store identifiers (`app_id`, `bundle_id`, `apple_id`, `store_url`) that platforms need to promote an app. Every listed type MUST also appear in the product's `catalog_types`.

catalog_types.description: Catalog types that satisfy the requirement (any-of). One catalog of any listed type satisfies it.

oneOf.title: Downstream connection requirement
oneOf.description: The product needs a seller-side platform connection or grant, such as an advertiser account or the publisher identity (page, profile, channel) the ads run as. It is satisfied by completing the connection, not by a request field. A missing, pending, expired, or revoked connection fails with `AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED` and `error.details.missing_connections[]` per `error-details/authorization-required.json`. Because a declared list is complete for its kinds, a seller that would reject a buy with `AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED` for a missing connection — including the advertiser account itself — MUST declare that connection here. When the account has several eligible connected identities, the seller applies its documented default; buyer-directed selection is not part of this surface.

connection.description: The required connection. Because the declaration is account-independent, `status` is omitted or `unknown` and `resource_ref` MUST be omitted.
